content.text:
.subckt DUT VIN VOUT VSS VREF
* PMOS series pass element sized for the 1 mA load at low VIN.
XPASS VOUT VGATE VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.15 nf=1 m=32

* Output divider and matched VIN level shifts put the NMOS pair inputs
* near 0.875 V at regulation while preserving their voltage difference.
RFTOP VOUT VFB 23k
RFBOT VFB VSS 47k
RFSIG VFB FBIN 100k
RFBIAS VIN FBIN 186k
RRSIG VREF REFIN 560k
RRBIAS VIN REFIN 650k

* NMOS differential pair: low FB reduces its branch current, so the
* PMOS mirror raises NOUT and the gate sink turns the pass device on.
XNREF NREF REFIN NTAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.25 nf=1 m=1
XNFB NOUT FBIN NTAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.25 nf=1 m=1
RLOADREF VIN NREF 100k
RLOADFB VIN NOUT 100k

* Resistor-set NMOS mirror biases the input-pair tail current.
XNBIAS NBIAS NBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=10 L=2 nf=1 m=1
RBIASN VIN NBIAS 100k
XNTAIL NTAIL NBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=20 L=2 nf=1 m=1

* NOUT is high when VOUT is low: the PMOS driver releases VGATE and
* its pull-down turns the pass element on. High VOUT drives VGATE up.
XPDRV VGATE NOUT VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XNGATE VGATE NOUT VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.15 nf=1 m=8
RBIASG VIN VGATE 100k
* CCOMP sets the error-node pole; CFF couples output droop to the gate.
CCOMP NOUT VSS 0.001p
CFF VOUT VGATE 29.8p
.ends DUT
